comparison.normalization: Every aligned row matched to target first, then ONE common attenuation for all12 rows and their cadence repeats. No row-specific peak limiting or post-encoding normalization.
comparison.prepared_source_note: Archive contains prepared original recordings, not claims of raw microphone audio.

rows.alignment_description: First5% of each rendered row peak aligned to2ms; negative shift means leading zero pad. No signal layers.
rows.gain_application: After FFmpeg graph and exact leading-sample alignment: multiply by10**(rms_match_gain_db/20), storefloat32; multiply by10**(global_final_attenuation_db/20), storefloat32; encodePCM24 withoutdither, then Vorbisquality7. No limiter.
